CLAREMONT CITY COUNCIL
  MEETING AGENDA
  “We are a vibrant, livable, and inclusive community dedicated to quality services,
  safety, financial strength, sustainability, preservation, and progress
  with equal representation for our community.”

City Council Chamber  Tuesday
225 Second Street  October 26, 2021
Claremont, CA 91711
  6:30 PM

  COUNCILMEMBERS

  JENNIFER STARK
  MAYOR

  COREY CALAYCAY  JED LEANO  SAL MEDINA  ED REECE

Pursuant to the local emergency concerning the COVID-19 virus declared by
the City Council of the City of Claremont on March 19, 2020, the Los Angeles
County Department of Health's "Safer at Home Order" issued March 19, 2020,
and Executive Order N-29-20 issued by Governor Gavin Newsom on March
18, 2020, the following protocols will apply to public participation for the
duration of the emergency:

Members of the public will not be permitted to be physically present at meetings. To allow for public
participation, the City Council will conduct its meeting through Zoom Video Communications. To
participate in the meeting from the comfort of your own home or office, download Zoom on any phone or
computer device and copy and paste the following link into your browser to access and participate in the
live City Council meeting at 6:30 p.m.: https://zoom.us/j/256208090 or to only listen from the phone dial
(213)338-8477,  Webinar  ID:  256 208 090.  For  assistance,  please  call  (909)399-5461 or
(909)399-5463.

Members of the public who wish to address the City Council on any matter listed on the agenda or a
subject matter within the jurisdiction of the City Council may utilize the following methods. The Council
requests, but does not require, the public speakers to identify themselves.

OPTION 1: LIVE COMMENTS - Through Zoom, someone wishing to speak may virtually "raise your
hand". Wait to be called upon by the City Clerk to provide verbal comments for up to four minutes. If you
are dialing in by telephone and wish to speak, please push *9. This will “raise your hand”.

OPTION 2: E-MAIL - Public comments may be sent via email to the City Clerk’s office at
sdesautels@ci.claremont.ca.us or jcostanza@ci.claremont.ca.us. All emails will be distributed to the
City Council and imaged into the City’s document archive system.
 Page 2  City Council Agenda  October 26, 2021

OPTION 3: MAIL - Public comments may be mailed to Claremont City Hall, Attn: City Clerk’s Office, PO
Box 880, Claremont, CA 91711. All comments received via mail will be distributed to the City Council
and imaged into the City’s document archive system.

OPTION 4: TELEPHONICALLY - Members of the public wanting to address the City Council
telephonically are requested to inform the Claremont City Clerk's office no later than 3:00 p.m. on the
day of the meeting.  The Claremont City Clerk's office can be reached at (909) 399-5461, (909)
399-5463, sdesautels@ci.claremont.ca.us, or jcostanza@ci.claremont.ca.us. You will be called during
consideration of the item you are interested in and given up to 4 minutes to speak.

The meeting will not be live streamed through Granicus as the meeting will be live streamed through
Zoom instead. The recorded meeting will be uploaded and saved as a record.

CALL TO ORDER THE MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

MOMENT OF SILENCE

ROLL CALL

CLOSED SESSION REPORT

CEREMONIAL MATTERS, PRESENTATIONS, AND ANNOUNCEMENTS

MAYOR AND COUNCIL

Council Items
1.  APPOINTMENT TO THE PLANNING COMMISSION
  Recommendation:  The City Council Ad Hoc Selection Committee recommends that the City
  Council appoint Mario Alvarez to the Planning Commission for a term to
  expire August 31, 2025.
2.  APPOINTMENT TO THE SAN GABRIEL VALLEY MOSQUITO ABATEMENT AND VECTOR
  CONTROL DISTRICT BOARD OF TRUSTEES
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends that the City Council appoint a delegate to serve on the
  San Gabriel Valley Mosquito and Vector Control District Board of Trustees
  for a two-year term commencing January 1, 2022.

Council Assignment Reports
City Councilmembers may serve as representatives on regional organizations. This time is
allocated for reports about their activities. For information about the Council's local,
intergovernmental  and  regional  appointments  please  visit  the  City website :
www.ci.claremont.ca.us/government/city-council/city-council-assignments-and-appointments.

CITY MANAGER REPORT
 Page 3  City Council Agenda  October 26, 2021

PUBLIC COMMENT
The Council has set aside this time for persons in the audience who wish to comment on items
that ARE NOT LISTED ON THIS AGENDA, but are within the jurisdiction of the City Council.
Members of the audience will later have the opportunity to address the City Council regarding ALL
OTHER ITEMS ON THE AGENDA at the time the Council considers those items.

At this time the Council will take public comment for 30 minutes. Public Comment will resume later
in the meeting if there are speakers who did not get an opportunity to speak because of the
30-minute time limit.

The Brown Act prohibits the City Council from taking action on oral requests relating to items that
are not on the agenda. The Council may engage in a brief discussion, refer the matter to staff,
and/or schedule requests for consideration at a subsequent meeting.

The Council requests, but does not require, speakers to identify themselves. When you come up
to speak, please state your name unless you wish to remain anonymous. Each speaker will be
allowed four (4) continuous minutes.

CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed on the consent calendar are considered to be routine. The City Council or one or
more Commissions and/or Committees have previously considered most of the items on the
consent calendar. The Council may act on these items by one motion following public comment.

Only Councilmembers may pull an item from the consent calendar for discussion.

The City Council will waive reading of resolutions and ordinances. Each resolution and ordinance
will be numbered following Council approval.

Now is the time for those in the audience to comment on the consent calendar. Each speaker will
be allowed four (4) continuous minutes to comment on items on the consent calendar.
3.  ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING THE CITY WARRANT REGISTER
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends that the City Council adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, ALLOWING
  CERTAIN CLAIMS AND DEMANDS AND SPECIFYING THE FUNDS OUT
  OF WHICH THE SAME ARE TO BE PAID, dated October 14, 2021.
  Attachment(s):  Resolution Approving City Warrant Register Dated October 14, 2021

4.  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES OF OCTOBER 12, 2021
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends that the City Council approve and file the regular City
  Council meeting minutes of October 12, 2021.
  Attachment(s):  Draft Regular Meeting Minutes of October 12, 2021
 Page 4  City Council Agenda  October 26, 2021

5.  RESOLUTION RECONFIRMING THE EXISTENCE OF A STATE OF EMERGENCY DUE TO
  THE COVID-19 PANDEMIC
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends that the City Council, in consideration of the ongoing state
  of emergency due to the COVID-19 pandemic, and existing public health
  orders, adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, RECONFIRMING THE EXISTENCE OF A
  STATE OF EMERGENCY DUE TO THE COVID-19 PANDEMIC.
  Attachment(s):  Resolution

6.  SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF AN ORDINANCE UPDATING THE CLAREMONT
  MUNICIPAL CODE- CITY-INITIATED (FUNDING SOURCE: GENERAL FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends that the City Council waive further reading and adopt AN
  ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CLAREMONT,
  CALIFORNIA, ADOPTING A CODE AMENDMENT TO IMPLEMENT AN
  UPDATE TO THE CLAREMONT MUNICIPAL CODE, APPLICANT - CITY OF
  CLAREMONT.
  Attachment(s):  Draft Ordinance
  Redline Version Showing Proposed Changes

7.  INVESTMENT REPORT - QUARTER ENDING SEPTEMBER 30, 2021
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends that the City Council receive and accept the Investment
  Report for the quarter ending September 30, 2021.
  Attachment(s):  Quarterly Investment Report

8.  QUARTERLY FINANCIAL UPDATE - SEPTEMBER 30, 2021
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the Quarterly
  Financial Update, dated September 30, 2021.
9.  SUSTAINABILITY ANNUAL REPORT 2019-2020 (FUNDING SOURCE: GENERAL FUND
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the Sustainability
  Annual Report 2019-2020.
  Attachment(s):  Sustainability Annual Report 2019-2020
  Excerpt from the 9/13/21 Sustainability Committee Meeting
  Excerpt from the 10/6/21 CHS Commission Meeting
 Page 5  City Council Agenda  October 26, 2021

10. AUTHORIZATION TO AMEND THE EXISTING PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT
  WITH DUDEK ENVIRONMENTAL PLANNING FOR ENVIRONMENTAL REVIEW SERVICES
  FOR THE CLARA OAKS DEVELOPMENT AND AWARD OF CONTRACT TO DUDEK
  ENVIRONMENTAL PLANNING TO DEVELOP A SPECIFIC PLAN FOR THE CLARA OAKS
  DEVELOPMENT (FILE #17-SP02) (FUNDING SOURCE: PROJECT APPLICANT)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends that the City Council:
  A. Authorize the City Manager to execute an amendment to the professional
  services agreement with Dudek Environmental Planning for environmental
  review services related to the Clara Oaks development, increasing
  compensation by $31,340; and
  B. Authorize the City Manager to enter into a professional services
  agreement with Dudek Environmental Planning in the amount of $59,640 to
  complete a Specific Plan for the Clara Oaks project.
  Attachment(s):  Dudek Change Order for Contract Amendment
  Dudek Scope of Work for Specific Plan

11. AWARD OF CONTRACT TO PSOMAS TO CONDUCT ENVIRONMENTAL REVIEW
  SERVICES FOR THE CLAREMONT CORPORATE YARD TRANSFER STATION SOLID
  WASTE FACILITY PERMIT (FUNDING SOURCE: SANITATION FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends that the City Council:
  A. Authorize the City Manager to enter into an agreement with Psomas for an
  amount not to exceed $34,875 for the preparation of an addendum for the
  Claremont Corporate Yard Transfer Station Solid Waste Facility Permit; and
  B. Appropriate $34,875 from Sanitation Fund balance to fully fund the
  agreement.
  Attachment(s):  Psomas Bid Proposal for Addendum Preparation
  Minutes Excerpt from the 11/23/20 CHS Meeting Minutes

12. 2021 DEPARTMENT WORK PLANS - THIRD QUARTER UPDATE (FUNDING SOURCES:
  VARIOUS)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council receive and file the third quarter update
  of the 2021 Department Work Plans.
  Attachment(s):  2021 Work Plan - Third Quarter Update

PUBLIC HEARINGS - None
 Page 6  City Council Agenda  October 26, 2021

ORDINANCE
13. AMENDMENT TO TITLE 9 OF THE CLAREMONT MUNICIPAL CODE REGULATING THE
  SALE AND USE OF FIREWORKS (FUNDING SOURCE: GENERAL FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends that the City Council introduce AN ORDINANCE OF THE
  CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, AMENDING
  TITLE 9 OF THE CLAREMONT MUNICIPAL CODE REGULATING THE SALE
  AND USE OF FIREWORKS for first reading and that reading be by title only.
  Attachment(s):  Proposed Ordinance
  Blue-Lined Version Showing Changes

ADMINISTRATIVE ITEM
14. 2020-21 GENERAL FUND UPDATE (UNAUDITED)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends that the City Council:
  A. Allocate $1,000,000 of the 2020-21 General Fund surplus for an additional
  discretionary payment to CalPERS to pay down the unfunded liability on the
  City's employee pension plans;
  B. Allocate $1,000,000 of the 2020-21 General Fund surplus for a
  contribution to fund the City's Section 115 Pension Trust;
  C. Approve the proposed Section 115 Pension Trust Policy;
  D. Allocate $1,000,000 of the 2020-21 General Fund surplus to the City's
  Operating and Environmental Emergency Reserve;
  E. Allocate $898,068 of the 2020-21 General Fund surplus to the City's
  Equipment and Facility Revolving Reserve; and
  F. Allocate $300,000 of the 2020-21 General Fund surplus for future open
  space acquisitions and implementation of the Wilderness Park Master Plan.
  Attachment(s):  Proposed Section 115 Pension Trust Policy

CONTINUED PUBLIC COMMENT
This time is reserved for those persons who were unable to speak earlier in the agenda because
of the 30-minute time restriction.

COMMISSIONS

  No Vacancies, One Pending Appointment

ADJOURNMENT

THE NEXT REGULAR MEETING OF THE CLAREMONT CITY COUNCIL WILL BE HELD ON,
NOVEMBER 9, 2021, AT 6:30 P.M., VIA ZOOM.
 Page 7  City Council Agenda  October 26, 2021

A LOOK AHEAD – Upcoming Meetings and Tentative Agenda Items

  - City Warrants
  - Draft October 12, 2021 City Council Minutes
  - Resolution Declaring Continued Existence of an Emergency Due to COVID-19
  - Second Reading and Adoption of Ordinance Prohibiting Fireworks
  - CalFIRE Grant Authorization for the Removal and Replacement of Diseased Trees
  - Award Contract for Traffic Control Signs and Equipment
  - Claremont Museum of Art Lease Amendment
  - Ordinance Regulating Organics Recycling

MATERIALS RELATED TO AN ITEM ON THIS AGENDA, AND SUBMITTED TO THE CITY COUNCIL
AFTER PUBLICATION OF THE AGENDA, ARE AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC IN THE CITY CLERK’S
OFFICE AT 207 HARVARD AVENUE, CLAREMONT, MONDAY THROUGH THURSDAY, 7 AM – 6
PM. SUBJECT MATERIALS WILL BE MADE AVAILABLE ON THE CITY WEBSITE AS SOON AS
POSSIBLE - www.ci.claremont.ca.us. For more information, please call the City Clerk’s Office at
909-399-5461.

IN COMPLIANCE WITH THE AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES ACT 0F 1990, THIS AGENDA WILL
BE MADE AVAILABLE IN APPROPRIATE ALTERNATIVE FORMATS TO PERSONS WITH
DISABILITIES. ANY PERSON WITH A DISABILITY WHO REQUIRES A MODIFICATION OR
ACCOMMODATION IN ORDER TO PARTICIPATE IN A CITY MEETING SHOULD CONTACT THE
CITY CLERK AT 909-399-5461 “VOICE” OR 1-800-735-2929 “TT/TTY” AT LEAST THREE (3)
WORKING DAYS PRIOR TO THE MEETING, IF POSSIBLE.

I, SHELLEY DESAUTELS, CITY CLERK OF THE CITY OF CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, HEREBY
CERTIFY UNDER PENALTY OF PERJURY THAT THE FOREGOING AGENDA WAS POSTED AT
CLAREMONT CITY HALL, 207 HARVARD AVENUE, ON  OCTOBER 21, 2021, PURSUANT TO
GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54954.2.

POST THROUGH: October 27, 2021
